thread:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a spike in tool-call errors when requests got routed to fallback variants in eu-west yesterday. Error rate ~3.2% for tier=standard :grimacing:
kevin: Seen that. Any pattern? tokenizer mismatch? context truncation?
sora: I pulled traces. Looks like the fallback variant (gptx-small-q8) has a different tokenizer config and max_seq, so tool-call JSON sometimes gets trimmed mid-key. e.g. payload loses the trailing `tool_args` field -> parse failure.
kevin: Ugh. So smart routing decided cost-tier <-> region fallback without checking "tool-call compatible" flag. That should be part of the policy.
maria: Agreed. We need a per-variant compatibility matrix surfaced in Console (and enforced in Router). Minimal columns: tokenizer_id, max_seq, supports_toolcalls (bool), kv_cache_compat, deterministic-tokenization (for eval parity).
jamie: +1 for Console column and an API endpoint so infra can gate routing: `GET /internal/variants/{id}/compat` returns flags.
kevin: Also quotas: some customers hit dedicated quota throttle and router bounced to standard tier in eu-west where the compatible variant differs. Need to ensure quota-induced fallback respects toolcall parity.
sora: Proposed quick fix: add an extra check in routing policy: allow_fallback_if variant.supports_toolcalls == true AND variant.max_seq >= request_context_len. I can PR.
maria: Please add telemetry for mismatches: metric names we can use: `router_toolcall_mismatch_total`, `variant_truncation_rate`, and a tag for `customer_tier`+`region`. Dashboards should show top 10 customers by mismatch.
kevin: For rollout UX: when we flip a canary that changes tokenizer (even small), Console should warn: "This rollout may break tool-calling for customers using payloads > X tokens" and offer an auto-block option for affected routes.
jamie: On the infra side, the Router needs a fast cache for the compat flags to avoid extra RPC on hot paths. Maybe embed flags in the model-catalog snapshot used by the router.
sora: I'll work on PR for Router + catalog snapshot update. Also adding a light-weight integrity check at ingress that verifies `Content-Length` ~= tools payload length and logs if truncated.
maria: For the matrix visual, UX idea: heatmap with rows=variants, cols=capabilities, yellow for "partial parity" (e.g., tokenizer matches but max_seq smaller), red for "incompatible". Link each cell to the exact config diff.
kevin: One more edgecase — regional quantization can change tokenization in rare models (padding differences). Add `tokenizer_checksum` to the compat flags so we can detect binary drift between builds.
jamie: Good call. ops-bot: deploy-bot will schedule a canary for the Router change tomorrow 03:00 UTC after PR review. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: router-compat-checker v0.1 -> 10% eu-west traffic at 2026-03-19T03:00:00Z
sora: Thanks — I'll add unit tests and an e2e that simulates a tool-call payload getting truncated so we catch regressions.
maria: Cool. Action items: sprints: 1) add compat flags to model catalog + checksum (sora), 2) Router gating + cache (kevin/jamie), 3) telemetry + Dashboards (maria), 4) Console rollout warnings (product + ux). I'll open a tracking ticket and tag teams. :white_check_mark:
